maya: quick update from slice-bench on 13B int4 bringup. results look okay overall but we saw regressions on legal and multi-hop reasoning slices.
jordan: can you paste the failing sample rates?
maya: top-level summary: int8 baseline cost 1.0x, int4 cost ~0.35x. overall F1 down ~0.9% absolute. legal_contracts slice F1 down 4.8%. multi-hop reasoning exact_match down 3.2%.
sam: that's borderline for product SLAs. what's latency and token econ?
maya: latency ~= unchanged at 512 tokens. unit cost per 1k tokens: hosted int8 $0.012, int4 $0.0042 (est). rough saving ~65% on model compute.
ciaran-bot: [benchmark run] run_id: br-20260301-47
```
model: rv-13b
quant: int4
slices: legal_contracts, multi-hop, chit-chat
metrics: f1, em, rouge
summary: overall delta -0.9% f1
```
jordan: do we have repro prompts/examples for the legal slice? we need targeted evals with quality guards.
maya: uploaded repro set to /s3/internal/slicebench/legal_contracts_20260301.jsonl link: https://s3.redwood/internal/legal_contracts_20260301.jsonl
sam: recommendation options: A) keep int8 for prod-critical routes (legal, reasoning) and route other traffic to int4. B) keep int4 but add a small rerank stage using 7b-int8 for legal. C) run LoRA fine-tune on legal domain to recover quality.
jordan: cost impact estimates?
maya: A) routing: companywide saving ~45%. B) rerank: +8% cost, empirically recovers ~3.5% F1 on legal. C) LoRA fine-tune: one-time ~10k training cost, recovers ~4.2% F1 on slice and improves generalization.
sam: product preference? @olivia any constraints? :thinking:
olivia: short-term prefer lowest risk -> choose A (per-route quantization). mid-term pursue C if legal traffic grows. B needs PRD for rerank.
maya: proposed action: implement per-route quantization routing + add regression alert in slicebench (>2% drop on critical slices) + schedule LoRA experiment next sprint. i'll open an FR and notebook.
jordan: lgtm. please add unit econ sim with expected traffic mix.
maya: will do. attaching quick unit econ calc below.
maya: 
```
assumptions: 60% general, 20% legal, 20% reasoning
costs: int8 0.012/1k, int4 0.0042/1k, rerank 0.0025/1k
scenario A cost = 0.6*int4 + 0.4*int8 = 0.6*0.0042 + 0.4*0.012 = 0.00252 + 0.0048 = 0.00732
baseline int8 cost = 0.012 -> saving ~39%
```
sam: thanks. can you add a small smoke check in canary to watch for regression before full rollout?
maya: yes, adding canary + automated eval on new prompts. will update thread with FR id.
